field.name: mode
field.comment: S: the event in eventID is displayed; P: the one held by the page attribute named by calendarEventAttributeKeyHandle; R: the occurrence passed through the URL

field.name: calendarEventAttributeKeyHandle
field.comment: The handle of the page attribute holding the event to be displayed (used if mode is P)

field.name: calendarID
field.comment: The ID of the calendar the event belongs to

field.name: eventID
field.comment: The ID of the event to be displayed (used if mode is S)

field.name: displayEventAttributes
field.comment: A JSON array of the IDs of the event attributes to be displayed

field.name: allowExport
field.comment: true: the visitors are offered a link to add the event to their own calendar; false or NULL: they are not

field.name: enableLinkToPage
field.comment: true: the name of the event links to the page that the event is bound to, opening it at the occurrence being displayed; false or NULL: the name is not a link

field.name: displayEventName
field.comment: true: the name of the event is displayed; false or NULL: it's left out

field.name: displayEventDate
field.comment: true: the date of the event is displayed; false or NULL: it's left out

field.name: displayEventDescription
field.comment: true: the description of the event is displayed; false or NULL: it's left out
